subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Food delivery services provide meal delivery for customers.
• In centralized delivery, restaurants prepare orders that are picked up from designated distribution centers.
• Centralized systems are efficient and maintain quality control but require substantial infrastructure and startup costs.
• In direct delivery, drivers collect orders directly from individual restaurants.
• Direct delivery systems are relatively quick to establish and offer restaurants independence in operations.
• Direct delivery systems can suffer from inconsistent service quality.
prompt: The student wants to compare some disadvantages of centralized and direct food delivery systems. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Direct delivery systems can suffer from inconsistent service quality; centralized systems, on the other hand, maintain quality control and efficiency.
choices.B: Worth noting is that while direct delivery systems are relatively quick to establish, they offer less independence to restaurants than centralized systems.
choices.C: Centralized systems require more infrastructure investment than direct delivery systems, but they avoid some of the latter's quality control issues.
choices.D: Though direct delivery systems offer restaurants independence, centralized food delivery services provide meal delivery for customers.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence compares some disadvantages of centralized and direct food delivery systems, explaining that while centralized systems require more infrastructure investment (substantial infrastructure and startup costs), direct delivery systems have quality control issues.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence emphasizes an advantage of direct delivery systems, then makes a general statement that applies to both types of systems; it doesn't compare disadvantages of the two types of systems.
